dex.entry: A massive iron-ore golem whose body is now a dense interlock of stone and metal; each strike sends shockwaves through the mine tunnel walls. The iron golem that grew from a grub — the shock of scale makes its evolution line feel rewarding.

art.silhouette: Imposing wide-shouldered biped; entire body studded with iron-ore protrusions and plates; massive stone fists each larger than a human torso; slow-burning orange eyes set deep in a craggy face; silhouette is pure power.
